text:
jess: quick heads-up — hit a reproducible divergence when joining KV shards with the new runtime join path. short repro attached.

kai: can you summarize numbers?

jess: ran rwd-30b-int8, 64k context, shards=4, merge-policy=runtime-join. baseline vs join are identical up to ~2k tokens, then outputs slowly drift. diff shows logits off by ~1e-2 around token 2048 then amplify.

anika: hmm. RoPE scaling or a prefill alignment issue?

jess: tried toggling rotary rescale. with rescale=1.0 divergence at 2048. with rescale=0.5 it tracks baseline to ~8k. suggests phase amplification interacting with quantized accumulate on merge.

lina: do we have a minimal command to repro on devbox?

jess: yep: `./tools/run_kv_merge_test --model rwd-30b-int8 --shards 4 --merge-policy runtime-join --seq 65536 --seed 73 --dump-kv /tmp/kvdump.pb`

build-bot: started job kv-merge-20765 on devbox-5 at 2026-11-12T10:12:03Z

ci-bot: kv-merge-20765 finished: PASS (bit-diff 0..2047 match, divergence starts at 2048+) :eyes:

kai: thinking out loud — maybe the runtime join doesn't normalize rotary phase offsets across shards (offset accumulation). if each shard had a different priming length, merge might misalign indices used for rotation.

anika: adding a targeted test: run join with `--align-by-prefix` and `--enforce-phase-clip`. if that pushes the break point, it's alignment.

jess: I also dumped raw KV tensors before/after merge. memcpy looks fine, but the order of KV keys vs positions seems shifted by one in some merges (seen in hex dump). could be off-by-one when compacting shards.

lina: please upload the dumps. I'll try the same run on devbox-3 (different NIC/hw) to rule out DMA reorder oddness.

jess: uploaded artifacts to /mnt/artifacts/2076543210/ (kvdump.pb, logits.diff, run.sh, repro README). small snippet of the log: 
``` 
[run] seq=65536 shards=4 merge=runtime-join
[step 2047] token=2047 topk=5 same
[step 2048] token=2048 top1 baseline="the" join="a" logits_delta=0.0123
[step 4096] token=4096 top1 baseline="and" join="and" logits_delta=0.45
```

build-bot: artifact kvdump.pb (11.2MB) uploaded to /mnt/artifacts/2076543210/kvdump.pb

anika: one more datapoint — I ran the same sequence with rwd-30b-fp16 (no quant) and join path matches baseline perfectly to 64k. strongly points to quantization path during merge.

kai: ok that narrows it. two hypotheses: 1) int8 rounding + merge order causes cumulative bias; 2) memcpy/packing used a different alignment/padding per shard, shifting positions.

jess: I added a tiny patch that enforces 16-byte alignment on KV packing and re-ran: divergence moved from 2048 to ~8192. PR posted: #2621  (comment: small runtime packing change).

lina: good progress. if packing shift delayed divergence, packing/alignment is a big suspect. we should add cross-shard checksum at merge boundaries to detect early.

anika: I'll take this as the lead. will add a suite to fuzz join with random priming lengths and assert checksums before/after merge. also will test `--align-by-prefix` flag across quantized models.

kai: reassign to eng-runtime if anika confirms it's not just packing — might need kernel fix.

jess: thanks all. leaving notes in the PR and the repro directory. ping me if you need the exact kv offsets.

lina: noted for release risk triage. thanks! :thumbsup:
